```sql
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN s."OpenDate" IS NULL THEN 'Unknown'
        WHEN s."OpenDate" < '2010-01-01' THEN 'Before 2010'
        WHEN s."OpenDate" < '2012-01-01' THEN '2010-2011'
        WHEN s."OpenDate" < '2014-01-01' THEN '2012-2013'
        WHEN s."OpenDate" < '2015-09-01' THEN '2014-2015'
        ELSE 'After 2015-09-01'
    END AS charter_auth_window,
    AVG(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)") AS avg_free_meal_rate
FROM main."frpm" f
LEFT JOIN main."schools" s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  AND (s."OpenDate" IS NULL OR s."OpenDate" <= '2015-09-01')
GROUP BY charter_auth_window
ORDER BY charter_auth_window
```
